fills.researcher_notes: The operator's history book, read through the May 2022 archived copy, says the Shkapovo, Belebey and Tubankul pipeline runs 84 kilometers from the Shkapovo gas plant to the gas station at Tubankul. The sheet value of 84 is the same. The entry is from the start of construction in August 1956.
The operator's history book gives a pipe diameter of 377 millimeters for the Shkapovo, Belebey and Tubankul pipeline. The sheet value of 377 is the same.
